games.name: Survive from all Siren Heads 2
games.desc:
This game is inspired by Midnight Horrors.

This game is different and similar to the original game "Survive From all Siren Heads" but this game has better siren heads, more maps, and more gamepasses and much more!

This game is about surviving different versions of siren heads. whenever the intermission ends, a random siren head will spawn in to hunt at a random target. once the timer is done, the siren head will be gone, and the intermission starts again. there is a chance a special round would begin. A new map will sometimes change. 

These siren heads are from the marketplace, my remakes, and siren heads I got permission from my friends.

Credits to all people who owns a siren head model and it's in my game!

games.name: [VOICE CHAT] Bisley, England Beta
games.desc:
Bisley, England is a highly detailed UK:RP experience set in the heart of Gloucestershire. Explore a true-to-life 1:1 scale map of the historic village of Bisley, complete with realistic British architecture, countryside roads, and local landmarks.

🚗 Drive Realistic Vehicles – Choose from a wide range of accurately modelled vehicles, all with authentic handling and features.

🏡 Live the British Life – Go to work, own a house and immerse yourself in the daily life of a Bisley resident.

📍 Authentic Environment – From narrow lanes to classic stone buildings, every inch of Bisley has been carefully recreated for realism.

☁️ Weather - Enjoy classical, British weather from clear blue skies to sudden downpours.
